headline: Diablo
title: Diablo Facts | It Was Almost Turn Based | Classic Games
video_script: Diablo shipped at the end of nineteen ninety six, made by Condor, later Blizzard North. It was first planned as a turn based game. The team voted for real time combat, and creator David Brevik built a working prototype fast. Multiplayer came late, when a team helped add Battle dot net. Brevik named it after Mount Diablo near his school in California. Warrior, rogue or sorcerer? Comment below!
description: Diablo (1996): originally turn based, switched to real time by David Brevik's team, Battle.net added late, named after Mount Diablo in California.
